title: Incredible family experience.
text: The gourmet rice course was super dynamic, participative, and had a great atmosphere. Professor Héctor conducted a very enjoyable class; each group prepared a type of rice, we learned many techniques, and best of all, at the end of the class, we were able to eat the rice and paellas, everything was delicious, highly recommended!

title: Authentic Techniques of Traditional Spanish Dishes
text: We had an amazing time making tapas and paella with Jimena. My wife, daughter, and I had a great time cooking and chatting with Jimena in a private lesson. My daughter (4 YO) was a little too shy to engage with the class, but my wife and I enjoyed being instructed by and cooking alongside Jimena. She is a Le Cordon Bleu-trained chef who taught us the traditional techniques of paella but also offered a wealth of information on different varieties. Highly recommend!
author: vitalemd

title: Taller de cocina
text: Great cooking workshop at Sabores Taller de Cocina! We learned how to make paella, sangria, and tortilla de patatas with Professor Jimena, our teacher. The class was in English, very well organized, and a lot of fun. Perfect activity for team building.  Definitely worth it!
author: 879ariadnag

title: Amazing Spanish cooking workshop in Sabores taller de cocina in english
text:
We had an amazing Spanish cooking workshop in Sabores taller de cocina with CheffJimena! 🇪🇸
During the session we learned how to prepare some classic dishes like paella, pan tumaca, and tortilla de patatas. Jimena was a fantastic teacher—super friendly, clear, and passionate about Spanish cuisine. She made the whole experience fun, interactive, and easy to follow.
It was a great activity for team building. Cooking together, sharing the tasks, and then enjoying the food we made created a really relaxed and collaborative atmosphere.
